thread:
Diana: Heads up — we got a request from a mid-size healthtech POC asking for an 'early-access offset' on commits. They want 50% commit credit applied to the first 3 months. wondering if this is allowed under the current ratecard? cc @Mike @Ashley :thinking:
Mike: Are you saying 50% off committed spend or 50% extra commit credit (i.e., 1.5x credit)? need clarity before routing to deal desk.
Diana: Their language: "apply a 50% offset to monthly committed usage during the first 3 billing cycles" — so basically a charge reduction, not extra credit.
Ashley: That sounds like a promo/discount waiver. We have precedent but usually capped and requires Deal Desk sign-off if >30% or affects SKU mapping.
Mike: OK. what's the expected ARR/commit size?
Diana: Estimate ~$42k ARR, monthly cadence. They signed an LOI for a 6-month pilot.
Jordan: tagging in salesops — please include customer name (Anthera Health) and attach the draft LOI. Also need to confirm whether this is combinable with existing POC promo SKU.
DealBot: AUTOMATED ROUTE: Deal Desk review required — custom discount >30% or invoice adjustments. Route: sales->dealdesk->legal. Priority: medium. Reference: policy/ratecard/v2026/discounts.
Mike: If it's >30% then Deal Desk will want a business justification + short-term block (we usually treat this as a one-time billing credit). Can we restructure as a time-limited coupon applied on invoice rather than changing ratecard? easier ops-wise.
Diana: Customer prefers the discount applied to usage to keep their internal finance org happy (shows lower burn). They explicitly said "billing credit is acceptable but prefer it reflected on monthly invoices as reduced line-items."
Ashley: Ops note: reconfiguring invoices for reduced line-items triggers reconciliation work. If we do coupon/credit, it shows as separate credit line. Both fine but ops cost differs. Recommend coupon + special terms in SOW to avoid modifying standard ratecard.
Mike: For approval path: create a Deal Desk case with: customer, commit amount, requested discount %, start/end dates, reason (early access/promo), proposed accounting treatment (invoice credit vs ratecard change), recommended approver (Head of Sales Ops). I'll draft.
Diana: I'll attach the LOI and customer note. Also flagging security reqs — they asked for SOC2 attestations during POC. Not blocking but helpful to include in SOW.
Jordan: Added requested attachments. Quick checklist for the Deal Desk case:
```
- Customer: Anthera Health
- Commit: $42k ARR (monthly)
- Request: 50% offset on months 1-3
- Proposed treatment: invoice credit (preferred) or fixed-ratecard override
- Compliance: SOC2 in 30 days
- Duration: Pilot (6 months)
- Approval ask: Deal Desk + Sales Ops
```
Ashley: I'll pre-clear finance on reconciliation cost. If finance signs off on invoice credits, we can approve conditionally.
DealBot: STATUS UPDATE: Case created DE-2026-487. Waiting on Deal Desk review.
Mike: Great. If Deal Desk pushes back, be prepared to offer 30% cap or a reduced 3-month structure (e.g., 40% month1, 30% month2, 20% month3) — gives negotiation room.
Diana: noted. I'll keep the customer warm and say it's under internal review. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Ashley: looping back once finance responds.
Jordan: placing a calendar reminder for follow-up in 48h.
Diana: closing loop — will post Deal Desk decision here when available.
